rules.constructor: insert 1 copies of max(parent)+1 at after_first_max
rules.decomposition: remove all maxima; require exactly 1 and exact reconstruction

rules.constructor: insert 2 copies of max(parent)+1 at after_first_max
rules.decomposition: remove all maxima; require exactly 2 and exact reconstruction

obligations.statement: Any structural hypotheses used to justify this decomposition hold throughout the source class.
Each constructor sends every eligible parent to a source-class member.
Every non-atomic source member belongs to a recursive branch.
Atoms and branches are pairwise disjoint with no constructor collisions.
Removing maxima and constructing are mutual inverses in both directions.
All recursive children have strictly smaller nonnegative degree.
The derivation-count equation equals the class counting equation at all degrees.
